info.title: Socratic API
info.description: API for the Socratic platform — handles users, classes, topics, chat sessions, achievements, friends, OAuth accounts, and Google Calendar integration.

post.summary: Exchange Google Auth Code for Tokens

200.description: A list of upcoming calendar events

post.summary: Upload Document to S3 and Pinecone
post.description: Uploads PDF documents (syllabi, textbooks, or slides) to AWS S3, processes them with LangChain PDFLoader and RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, and upserts them into a class-shared Pinecone namespace for Socratic AI retrieval.

file.description: The PDF file(s) to upload. (Supports multiple files if sent as multiple 'file' keys)

classCode.description: The unique class identifier (e.g. 'CS 1436'). This organizes documents into a shared knowledge base for all students in that class.

docType.description: Categorizes the document. This help the Socratic AI understand the context (e.g. 'According to the slides...').

200.description: Documents successfully ingested into S3 and vectorized in Pinecone
